children.title: Settings
children.expression: (/* null keeps every column in the table */ $v := function($x) { $exists($x) ? $x : null }; $global := $all('config', 'dj-config')[category = 'ui']; $roles := value.roles.$read('config', 'dj-role', $); $user := value.properties; $distinct([$global[$lookup($, type) != null].ID, $roles.$keys(properties), $keys($user)]).($k := $; $g := $global[ID = $k].$lookup($, type); $merge([{'setting': $k, 'effective': [$g, $roles.$lookup(properties, $k), $lookup($user, $k)][-1], 'user': $v($lookup($user, $k))}, $roles.{'role ' & ID: $v($lookup(properties, $k))}, {'global': $v($g)}])))
